web-guide-idea-103.audience: People who want to understand a farm across the seasons.
web-guide-idea-103.offer: Offer regular glimpses of the work between major harvest events. Explain what the crop needs today and why.
web-guide-idea-103.steps.0: Choose a task that is safe to narrate.
web-guide-idea-103.steps.1: Show the crop and explain the day’s decision.
web-guide-idea-103.steps.2: Recap progress for people joining late.
web-guide-idea-103.equipment: A phone on stable support, power bank and suitable protection from dust or weather.
web-guide-idea-103.returnReason: Following the same field over weeks creates continuity and visible change.
web-guide-idea-103.promotion: Share a crop update and name the day’s work. Keep the phone away from machinery.
web-guide-idea-103.metadataTitle: Khet Ka Roz Ka Kaam — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-103.metadataDescription: Show your regular farm routine and explain the work as viewers come and go. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
